takeaways: Static IP firewall rules and the allow Azure services checkbox give a false sense of security; trust in Azure SQL must be established per request through identity.
Replacing service principal secrets with managed identities and standing admin rights with just-in-time access through Entra PIM drastically shrinks the attack surface.
Copilot amplifies existing oversharing, so row-level security, ledger tables, identity-based segmentation and database-level auditing are needed before AI discovery and audits.
hook: Many Azure SQL environments still trust IP ranges, long-lived service principal secrets and permanent admin rights, which attackers and AI tools exploit easily. This episode shows cloud architects and database admins how to move to identity-based security with managed identities, just-in-time access and microsegmentation. Learn how to close audit gaps and prepare your data for Copilot.
